en: Rafa, congratulations once again, a
really tight match against Shapovalov,
today a match where you won more
comfortably, what improved in your game
specifically today?
Well, I think that match against Denis
gave me a lot of confidence, you know, I
push, you know, to the limit, you know,
and I worked very hard to win that
match, but yeah, everyone, every match
is tough, you know, so not because the
result, you know, seems a bit more
easier, that means that the match is
easier, you know, I think everyone plays
here very good, so I had to be my best
today to beat Tabilo and I had to be my
best level, you know, and in all the
matches here.
Tabilo beat you in Indian Wells, it was
a closer match in Washington which you
won today, more clearly in your favor,
how much do you and your dad spend time
analyzing opponents to work out a clear
strategy? Well, it's difficult, you
know, because I'm new in the tour, you
know, so all the players that I'm
playing, most of them are new for me,
but I mean, the players that I've
already played against, it's easier, you
know, to prepare a match, I could say,
because you can kind of have an idea
what you're gonna expect, but every
match is different, every tournament has
different conditions, so you just have
to be very focused, you know, on doing
the things right, and I think most
importantly to focus on yourself, you
know, not focusing on the opponent,
which is also important, but I think
more important in you.
Just lastly, you're so good at being
humble and staying in the moment,
remarkably so, is there a little boy
inside you jumping up and down that
you're winning all these matches?
Well, I'm happy obviously to get this
type of wins, you know, and to be able
to play in these big stages, you know,
and center court of the Masters 1000 is
something that I dreamed about when I
was a kid and when I used to watch all
the matches on TV, so yeah, super
grateful, you know, that in what
position, you know, I am now to be able
to play, but as always, and I've always
said to be the same kid, you know, as I
was when I used to watch the matches on
the TV. Congratulations once again.
Thank you.
